maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is mainly natural gas sales and delivery by NJNG utility and energy services, not repair or replacement work.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by households, businesses and wholesale gas customers; NJNG is a regulated utility billing private customers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through utility rate base, solar and pipeline/storage investment, not a steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: NJNG is a regulated gas distribution utility heating homes; customers cannot practically switch; storage and pipeline serve distributors.
